use_case_summary: SMB content SaaS using hosted inference for: summarization of uploaded docs, on-demand document search (embeddings + rerank), and automated customer email drafts. Targets: ~10-20 requests/minute at start, p95 latency goal <= 300ms for short prompts, cost-sensitive. Wants opt-out from training, configurable retention (prefer 30 days), audit logs and ability to purge prompt history. Model preference: small/medium open-ish models with proven latency/cost tradeoff; fallback routing acceptable for bursty traffic.
